scenarios.title: Interview while resolving terminology
scenarios.prompt: Use grill-with-docs for cancellation. CONTEXT.md says cancellation applies to an entire Order, but I want customers to cancel one OrderLine. The current code only cancels whole orders.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May silently replace the definition or interview without checking code.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Load both grilling and domain-modeling; surface the terminology/code contradiction, ask frontier decisions with recommendations, and update CONTEXT.md when the user resolves the term; keep implementation details out of the glossary.

scenarios.title: Record a durable decision selectively
scenarios.prompt: We have agreed during grill-with-docs that partner isolation requires separate billing storage despite higher operational cost. It is expensive to reverse and would surprise a future maintainer. We also renamed a temporary report heading.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May record every detail as an ADR or omit the durable tradeoff.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Offer a concise ADR for the storage decision under all three criteria; skip the temporary heading, preserve inline glossary updates, and continue the interview for remaining branches.
